evals.prompt: 我是运营，零编程基础，每周 6 小时，希望 12 周后能用 Python 自动整理 Excel 周报。请给我完整学习路径。
evals.expected_output: A personalized 12-week plan and validated interactive HTML growth map.
assertions: Diagnoses goal, baseline, time budget, and work scenario
Defines staged deliverables and pass criteria
Includes practice using realistic Excel reporting tasks
Produces a single-file HTML map with persistent checkable progress

evals.expected_output: A concise clarification that asks only for the information needed to design a useful path.
assertions: Does not invent a full roadmap
Asks about intended outcome and current baseline
Asks about time constraints and application context

evals.prompt: I know basic SQL and need a six-week analytics engineering roadmap for a new job, ten hours per week.
evals.expected_output: An evidence-based six-week roadmap adapted to the stated baseline and job outcome.
assertions: Uses the six-week and ten-hour constraints
Avoids reteaching basic SQL without reason
